text:
zach: heads-up: dedicated pool 'us-central-dedicated-2' at 97% GPU utilization, build queue latency spiking. Noticed a few evictions, queue backing up. Anyone seeing autoscaler activity?

maya: seeing the same in dashboards. Pool hasn't acquired new nodes since ~08:23 UTC. autoscaler shows quota errors in controller logs.

ops-bot: Autoscaler attempted scale-up at 08:24:12 UTC but received QuotaExceeded from cloud provider. Initiating configured fallback policy 'regional-fallback-v2' for non-SLA traffic.

ian: can confirm error in controller logs: 'Compute API: QuotaExceeded'. Not internal reservation — cloud account GPU quota is exhausted for the zone. Snippet from autoscaler logs:

```
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/autoscaler | tail -n 40
ERROR 2026-03-18T08:24:12Z quotaExceeded: requested gpus 8 > remaining 2
WARN  2026-03-18T08:24:14Z backoff triggered, next attempt in 60s
```

sara: do we want to move user-facing low-latency routes to hosted? We have hosted capacity but cost will spike. Suggest we only failover background/batch traffic first and rate-limit high-cost tenants.

zach: agree — prefer targeted failover. Can we flip routing tags so only non-interactive/background workloads migrate to hosted for now?

maya: i prepared a small patch to route background traffic. Will roll a canary at 20% then monitor. Command I'm going to run:

```bash
redwoodctl route update \--from dedicated/us-central-dedicated-2 \--to hosted/us-central \--tag fallback:background \--percent 20
```

ian: note — hosted has some spare cycles but if we push everything we'll saturate it and then cross-region fallback to us-east will kick in (high cost + latency). Set alert if hosted GPU util > 80% for >5m.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: Route update deployed (canary 20%) at 1778502468. Monitoring pipelines active.

sara: also disabling large-batch training/long-context jobs for 15m to free KV and GPU slots. I'll push a marketplace rule to throttle batch jobs.

zach: after 10m of canary traffic: queue lag dropped from ~420s to ~60s, dedicated pool util down to ~85%. Good. Hold at 20% for another 20m then consider 50% if stable.

maya: :thumbsup: i'll open the quota increase request with cloud-team and attach logs. Filing a post-incident ticket so we capture chase steps and owners.

ian: please add a cost tag 'emergency-hosted-fallback' to the route so finance can attribute the spike. I added it in the canary metadata.

oncall: summary for the incident channel: dedicated zone hit cloud GPU quota -> autoscaler blocked -> targeted hosted fallback applied for background workloads -> queue stabilized. Follow-ups: request GPU quota increase, autoscaler backoff tuning, and implement per-tenant burst caps. Thanks all for the quick triage.
